'''Hurcha Squadron''' was a small [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] that were used by the [[Dimok government]]. During the final stages of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Harkov]]'s [[Sepan campaign|campaign]] to end the [[Sepan Civil War]], Hurcha Squadron was dispatched by the [[Dimok (people)|Dimoks]] to attack the [[Ton-Falk-class escort carrier|Escort carrier]] ''[[Tropsobor]]'' the attack was a failure and the Y-wings were destroyed in battle.
